exposure: exposure to war conditions during pregnancy
cohort: 228 children born between May 1st, 1991 and November 19th, 1991 at the Department for Gynaecology and Obstetrics of the Vukovar hospital during the war
finding: Despite exposure to war conditions, there were no significant deviations found in obstetric complications, early perinatal outcome and overall perinatal mortality compared to expected rates.
